steps.en: Install uv, then add the server to your assistant as a plugin
steps.zh: 装好 uv，再把服务器作为插件装进你的助手

steps.en: On first start, downloads its patched Firefox (about a quarter of a gigabyte) once
steps.zh: 首次启动时自己下载一次打过补丁的 Firefox（约 250 MB）

steps.en: Give the assistant a browsing task in plain words, with a URL
steps.zh: 用大白话给助手一个带网址的浏览任务

steps.en: Opens a browser whose fingerprint comes from a seed, set inside the engine
steps.zh: 打开一个浏览器，指纹由种子决定、写在引擎内部

steps.en: Navigates, clicks and types with a human-looking pointer, and reads the page back
steps.zh: 像人一样移动指针去导航、点击、输入，再把页面内容读回给助手

value.en: Your assistant browses sites that show stock Playwright a captcha, without you assembling a stealth browser stack
value.zh: 助手能浏览那些对普通 Playwright 弹验证码的网站，你不用自己拼一套反检测浏览器

sources: README.md (Two ways to use this browser agent: uv install blocks; `claude plugin install invisible-playwright-mcp@feder-cr`; What to ask a web browsing agent: plain-English task with a pasted URL)
